system.description:
You extrude an opaque chrysalis from your own bodily fluids, spinning it around yourself into a tough, fibrous coffin — many ancient Tzimisce use it to sleep away the ages in safety.

Spend three Blood Traits and ten minutes to spin the Cocoon; it lasts as long as you wish, and you may emerge from it at no cost. It blocks sunlight and is flame-retardant, negating the first two Health Levels of fire damage you would take each turn. Any attacker striking you must first defeat the Cocoon's strength in a Static Physical Challenge against a difficulty of twice your Physical Traits. You may still use mental Disciplines inside so long as their requirements can be met (eye contact generally cannot).
